subject: Re: Finovate - overnight response policy proposal
messages:
From: Emily Rhodes <emily.rhodes@finovate.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@finovate.io
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0500
Subject: Overnight response expectations / request for temporary exception

Hi Lauren,

We shipped into production last month and have been generally happy with Redwood's performance. That said, we've observed slower response to P2 incidents overnight (00:00 - 06:00 ET) and want to discuss whether we can get temporary adjustment to the P2 response window while we ramp our internal monitoring team.

Specifically, we'd like to request:
- An exception to allow a 6-hour response window for P2s overnight for the next 90 days (current committed P2 is 4 hours).
- Confirmation that P1 coverage and escalation paths remain unchanged.
- A named on-call escalation contact if our internal rotation fails.

This request is time-sensitive because our procurement team is finishing the legal/ops sign-off and needs the operational note for their risk assessment.

Can you loop in the relevant on-call/support lead and confirm if Redwood can sign this temporary amendment (or propose alternatives)?

Thanks,
Emily Rhodes
Director of Platform Ops
Finovate
[Attachment: example-incident-log.csv]

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Hi Emily — thanks for the note and congrats on the rollout. I'm looping in Ben (Support Lead) and Marissa (CS) to scope an ops-side proposal.

High-level response: we can consider a time-limited adjustment to the P2 window overnight with conditions. Before we commit, Ben will outline mitigations (escalation contacts, synthetic checks, and a short on-call roster) so your procurement team has the operational guardrails written down.

Next steps I propose from our side:
1) Ben to propose a concrete schedule and escalation path today.
2) We provide a signed operational addendum (90-day term) if Finovate accepts the mitigations.
3) We share a DocuSign link and the completed SLA-exception-form for your countersign.

Attaching a draft form and our current on-call roster for visibility.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:28:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Overnight response expectations / request for temporary exception

Emily — quick technical note and proposed mitigations below.

Summary: We can offer a 90-day temporary increase to the overnight P2 response window from 4h -> 6h between 00:00-06:00 ET provided Finovate accepts three mitigations:
- Redwood will maintain full P1 coverage 24/7 with immediate paging to the engineering on-call.
- We will enable higher-fidelity synthetic checks for the Finovate production endpoints (5m frequency) and share alerts to your Ops Slack channel.
- Redwood will provide a named escalation contact and an alternate on-call phone number for those 90 days.

Escalation path (proposed):
1) Pager alert -> Redwood on-call engineer (P1 immediate; P2 within target window)
2) If no ack within 30 minutes (for P1 only), escalate to Support Lead (Ben Carter)
3) If still unacknowledged within 2 hours (P1), escalate to Head of Customer Reliability (Lauren Bishop)
4) For P2s overnight, if no resolution within 6 hours, we will schedule a post-mortem with Finovate and offer priority remediation planning.

I've attached an on-call shift roster (internal) and a pre-filled SLA-exception-form for your procurement team. Ben

Ben Carter
Support Lead, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: oncall-shift-roster.xlsx]
